launches.body:
Blueshoe is a full-stack law firm that helps people with everything from everyday legal issues to high-stakes litigation and trial.

People can access legal guidance directly through our web app or the AI interfaces where they are already seeking answers. If representation is needed, Blueshoe attorneys handle many cases all the way to resolution, equipped with cutting-edge data, AI-native tools, and operational support.

<https://youtu.be/dLk-LHxAa5Q>

**The Problem**

Every year in the United States, billions of dollars in legal needs go unmet because trustworthy, affordable help remains out of reach. Legal technology has been built for law firms and corporations, not the people seeking justice.

**Blueshoe changes that.** 

By bringing technology and legal services together, Blueshoe makes legal help more accessible, effective, and reliable with support across: 

* [Employment](https://www.blueshoe.com/for/employment)
* [Property & Housing](https://www.blueshoe.com/for/property-construction)
* [Personal Injury](https://www.blueshoe.com/for/medical-injury)
* [Consumer Protection](https://www.blueshoe.com/for/consumer-financial)
* [Product Liability](https://www.blueshoe.com/for/product-environment)
* [Commercial Disputes](https://www.blueshoe.com/for/creators)

**How we do it**

**1. Rebuilding the legal buying experience**

Today, millions of people turn to AI before they ever call a lawyer. Blueshoe meets them there. 

Anyone using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or other AI tools can connect directly with a Blueshoe attorney for a timely legal assessment and structured intake. All for a flat fee.

**2. Making elite trial lawyers accessible**

The lawyers winning the largest verdicts aren't advertising on billboards or chasing clicks on TikTok.

Blueshoe identifies, vets, and partners with exceptional trial lawyers, making high-quality representation accessible to the people who need it most.

**3. Helping lawyers do their best work**

Most lawyers spend too much time running a business and not enough time practicing law.

Blueshoe provides qualified clients, AI-native software, and centralized operations in a single system. Lawyers focus on strategy, advocacy, and outcomes.

**Who and why**

We're a [Harvard-trained lawyer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/casey-og/) and an [MIT engineer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kywan/).

We’re building the law firm for a generation that expects everything always-on. A firm where technology doesn't replace judgment, but amplifies it, and where scale makes justice more human, not less.

If you're up against a legal issue — or you're a lawyer who wants to build the future of law — visit us at [blueshoe.com](http://blueshoe.com).
